blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday allowed the House prosecution panel’s move to withdraw all but impeachment article II or Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. “The court accepts and confirms the prosecution’s manifestation… Articles I, III and IV from this point forward are hereby withdrawn,” Presiding Officer Francis Escudero said. After 38 days of presentation, lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro made the manifestation expressing intent to no longer pursue article I, III, and IV, referring to Duterte’s alleged misuse of confidential funds, bribery and grave threats, respectively.
